knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The defining features are one trainer, a group of people and individual coaching within a shared session.
Large-class style running is the named mistake. Clear zones and a stated group size are design fixes.
Group size is limited by venue, insurance and safety conditions. A price list or music choice does not set the limit.

practicalCriteria: The learner writes a group size range with a reason, and the assessor confirms the reason is tied to coaching coverage
The learner draws a floor plan with one zone per group and clear walkways, and the assessor checks each zone has its equipment
The learner records the occupancy limit as checked or blank, with an owner
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Stop any group that exceeds a confirmed occupancy limit
Stop a session where two groups share one zone
